jobs.description:
We have great opportunity for those seeking a new challenge, but also a fantastic place to work. Come grow with us!

SPS offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, legal and life insurance, transit program, referral bonuses, pet discounts, EAP, and a 401K with company match.

Schedule: Typically Monday - Friday, 7:30AM-4:30PM/8AM-5PM (Flexes based on area assisting with)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Giving amazing customer service to our onsite operation by scanning/delivering/tracking/reporting in and outgoing business packages and mail (via UPS, USPS, Fedex, etc).
  • Assisting the onsite personnel in retrieving their packages and providing records management in person, by email, by phone, or similar methods.
  • Oversee the onsite business center, which may include: office supply stocking, assisting with copy/print orders, conference room setup up, pantry inventory, or light facilities.
  • Serves as backup to route driving roles, which provide delivery to onsite personnel for packages, pallets, etc.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ year experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom, route driving, or similar services.
  • Valid U.S. Driver's License, must be at least 25 years old to meet our standards to company car insurance, and have had license for at least 5 years.
  • A positive and professional attitude with a willingness to go above and beyond for our customers.

  • Ability to perform the following types of physical activities: lift up to 50 pounds, push/pull to move equipment, bend/stoop/squat/kneel, and reach above shoulders
  • Background and experience working in a warehouse or loading dock environment, with exposure to varied weather conditions a plus.

What Warehouse Operations Contributes To Cardinal Health

Operations is responsible for materials handling and product distribution in a distribution or manufacturing environment. Includes warehousing and fulfillment of materials and products, transportation, inventory management as well as demand, supply and manufacturing planning.

Warehouse Operations is responsible for performing/controlling a combination of manual or automated tasks necessary for the receipt, storage, and shipment of product. This may include functions of receiving, picking, packing, shipping, staging, transporting, storage, delivery, etc. Also responsible for the efficient flow of products from the point of product receipt from vendors to the shipment of products (via prescribed service parameters) to a variety of internal and external customers.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

  • Are dependable and consistently show up on time
  • Have strong attention to detail
  • Can work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Are organized and like keeping things in the right place
  • Are comfortable working on your feet throughout your shift
  • Can follow established processes and instructions
  • Work well independently and as part of a team
  • Are comfortable doing repetitive tasks such as picking, packing, folding, tagging, and labeling merchandise
  • Take pride in sending out an accurate, well-presented order
  • Bring a positive attitude and are willing to help wherever needed

Previous retail, warehouse, inventory, stockroom, picking/packing, or fulfillment experience is helpful, but not required. We're happy to train the right person who is dependable, motivated, and willing to learn.

Physical Requirements

This is an active warehouse position that requires standing and moving throughout the workday.

The position regularly requires:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Bending, reaching, and moving around warehouse work areas
  • Picking merchandise from inventory locations
  • Packing, folding, tagging, and handling merchandise throughout the day
  • Lifting and carrying boxes weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

What Success Looks Like

Get the orders right and get them done.

Our stores receive the correct merchandise. Online customers receive the correct orders. Clothing gets tagged properly. Product is checked before it leaves the warehouse. Orders are completed efficiently, accurately, and on time.

You're someone the team can depend on to consistently get the details right.

About Alice & Wonder

Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based retail company offering fun, unique, and affordable apparel, accessories, gifts, and more.

We're a growing local business with a hardworking, team-oriented environment. We move quickly, help each other out, and believe you can get a lot done while still having fun at work.

We're looking for people who want to be part of the team and contribute to what we're building.

What We Offer

  • Paid time off
  • Paid sick time
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Fun, energetic work atmosphere
  • Team-oriented environment
  • Opportunity to learn different parts of a growing retail business
  • Employee growth opportunities

If you're organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and enjoy getting things done, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $17.50 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

  • How many years of experience do you have in warehouse, retail stockroom, inventory, picking/packing, or order fulfillment?

jobs.description:
Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate (Flexible Hours in West Chicago)
  • Location: West Chicago, IL
  • Hiring: UPS
  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in West Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in West Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Earnings: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $26.7k/Year)
  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

Opportunity in Chicago

Fast Facts

  • Part-Time Opportunity in Chicago: Receiving Associate
  • Based in: Chicago, IL
  • Company: FedEx Supply Chain
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our FedEx Supply Chain team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Warehousing And Distribution industry.

What You Get

  • Pay Rate: $17-$22/Hour (approx. $20.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: Weekly pay options may be available.
  • Perfect for students or those seeking supplemental income.

Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. Snapshot

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

Build the Route Before the Sun Comes Up

Every morning, thousands of UPS drivers jump into perfectly loaded trucks, turn the key, and hit the road. That seamless execution is only possible because of the UPS Preload Package Handler. Operating during the very early morning hours (typically 3:00 AM to 8:00 AM), you are the architect of the delivery route. You will stand inside the back of the brown package cars, catching packages off a high-speed conveyor belt and loading them sequentially based on the driver's route map. If you want a fast-paced, intensely physical part-time job that provides incredible union benefits and frees up your entire day, this is the most critical warehouse role at UPS.

Preload Operations

  • High-Speed Package Sorting: Read alphanumeric routing codes on packages flying down the conveyor belt. You must quickly identify which packages belong to the 3 or 4 trucks you are assigned to load.
  • Sequential Truck Loading: This is a game of high-stakes Tetris. You must physically load the packages onto the specific interior shelves of the package car in the exact order the driver will deliver them, ensuring the heaviest boxes are safely secured on the floor.
  • Extreme Physical Conditioning: Skip the gym forever. You will be continuously twisting, bending, reaching, and lifting packages weighing up to 70 pounds for 4 to 5 hours straight in a fast-paced, loud, industrial environment.
  • Quality Control: Identify leaking, crushed, or mislabeled packages and pull them off the line for the problem-solve team before they are loaded onto the delivery truck.

The Part-Time Union Advantage

The UPS Preload position is legendary for its benefits. Even as a part-time employee, after a brief waiting period, you receive the same zero-premium, top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance as full-time drivers. You are protected by the Teamsters union, receive regular wage increases, and get access to the "Earn and Learn" program, which provides massive tuition assistance for college students. Most importantly, Preload is the primary waiting list to become a highly-paid UPS Delivery Driver.

Requirements

Must be at least 18 years old. No driving license is required for this warehouse role. You must possess extreme physical stamina and athletic endurance to handle continuous heavy lifting up to 70 lbs. You must have the discipline to wake up and work extremely early morning hours (e.g., 3:00 AM starts). A reliable work ethic and ability to pass a background check are mandatory.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

Join a dynamic logistics team as a 3PL Pick & Pack Warehouse Associate, where your energy and attention to detail will drive efficient order fulfillment and inventory management. In this vital role, you will be responsible for accurately picking, packing, and preparing shipments for delivery, ensuring that each customer receives their order promptly and in perfect condition. Your proactive approach and commitment to safety will help maintain smooth warehouse operations, supporting the overall success of our distribution process. This position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in warehouse management systems, join a fast growing company, and contribute to a team oriented environment.

Responsibilities

  • Efficiently pick items using order picker equipment, RF scanners, barcode scanning technology, and manual handling techniques to fulfill customer orders accurately.
  • Pack products securely using appropriate packaging materials, ensuring quality control standards are met before shipment.
  • Operate warehouse equipment such as pallet stackers, pallet jacks, and other equipment safely following all safety protocols.
  • Load and unload shipments with precision, managing shipping & receiving processes while adhering to safety guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records within warehouse management systems (WMS) and conduct regular stock checks to support inventory management systems.
  • Assist with stocking bins and organizing materials within the warehouse for optimal workflow.
  • Support warehouse supervisors in daily operations.

Experience

  • Prior experience working in a warehouse environment or distribution center is preferred but not required; on the job training will be provided.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS), RF scanners, barcode scanning for logistics, and inventory management systems is highly advantageous.
  • Experience operating heavy equipment such as pallet stackers, pallet jacks, or similar material handling equipment is a plus.
  • Knowledge of safety protocols related to manual handling, heavy lifting, shipping & receiving procedures is essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform basic math calculations accurately for inventory counts and order processing.
  • Previous roles involving picking & packing, materials handling, or warehouse distribution contribute to success in this position.

This role is perfect for motivated individuals eager to grow their skills in warehouse operations while making a tangible impact on customer satisfaction through efficient logistics processes. We are committed to providing a safe work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized!

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

  • Who is a role model of yours and why?
  • How many minutes late to work is the sweet spot for being documented late?
  • Your long lost grandmother died and left you 1 Million Dollars, would you still work? and why?
  • Who deserves the raise, the person who is an average worker and has been at the company for 5 years or the person who is the best worker but has only been at the company for 6 months?
